item.title: Block, A.I. and the Front-Running of the Curve
item.description: Quant’s Yousef Khalili explores Block’s layoffs as a structural test of whether A.I. has evolved from a productivity enhancer into a headcount reducer. As markets reward margin expansion and firms rush to emulate Block, Khalili argues that sustainable advantage will depend on understanding how emerging execution layers can permanently redefine the balance between human judgment and machine capability.
